messages:
Kim: Quick sync from the postmortem: we need clear owners and short timelines for the KV cache OOM remediation (profiling, GC/compaction, eviction policy, and quick mitigation flags). Who can pick which?

Arjun: I9ll own profiling + repro scripts. Will run heapshots across the canary profile and attach pprof/text outputs. ETA: Wed EOD.

Taylor: I9ll take GC/compaction knobs and run fragmentation benchmarks. Draft params to try: `--kv-compact-threshold=0.25 --compact-interval=60s`. ETA: next Tue.

Noor: I9ll handle eviction policy + soft caps on prefix size. Prototype adaptive-LRU that scores by prefix-size and write-rate. ETA: Mon.

Ben: I9ll add emergency-mode flag + circuit-breaker for nodes: flip to read-only if mem > 90% for 45s. PR today for tests.

Kim: Good. Please add exact commands and a tiny reproduce script so SRE can run it in staging.

Arjun: Sample commands: `HEAPPROFILE=/tmp/heap ./kvnode --load-sim && pprof --text /tmp/heap.*` and `gcore <pid>` for full dumps. Will publish scripts.

Taylor: For benchmarks, I9ll measure 95th latency & compaction pause times. If compaction regresses latency we can try lower-frequency compaction or background-only passes.

Noor: For soft caps, plan is: default soft cap 64k, degrade to 32k for heavy nodes, then evict older prefixes. Will measure miss-rate impact.

Ben: PR posted: `feature/emergency-mode` (WIP). Includes a feature flag and unit tests.

OpsBot: Reminder: add owners to the postmortem board card and include ETA + rollback risk.

Kim: Action recap:
- Arjun: profiling + repro (Wed EOD)
- Taylor: GC compaction benchmarks + proposal (Tue)
- Noor: eviction & soft-cap prototype (Mon)
- Ben: emergency-mode PR & gate (PR posted, finish tests today)
- Kim: update postmortem board + schedule 25m check-in Friday

Noor: Also adding metrics: ghost_alloc_count and prefix_free_latency. Will open an obs PR.

Arjun: Found a pattern in initial heapshots: large contiguous allocations tied to long-lived prefixes. Will detail in the report.

Taylor: If fragmentation is dominant we should consider compact-on-idle heuristic. Will test.

Kim: OK locking owners. I'll create the calendar and board card now. If anything slips, update the card and ping me.

OpsBot: Calendar invite created: "KV memory remediation check-in" Fri 11:00. Card created on postmortem board.

Ben: Thanks0 will follow up with PR link in the card.

Kim: Thanks everyone, thread closed for now. Keep the board updated.
